name: Berlin
briefing: Following your overwhelming success in London, you have been transferred to Berlin. Your predecessor there failed miserably. Germany's new capital appears to be overrun with gourmets from Bonn. Watch out for the rivalry between Russian and Italian Mafia.
debriefing: After two years of constant rain in England and Germany, you have asked to be transferred to a sunny country, and New York HQ has granted your request.

name: London
briefing: You begin your life as - hopefully - a successful pizza chef. Your boss sits in New York and has selected you from the many applications to be his new regional manager. Since the English are infamous for having no taste where food is concerned, you shouldn't have too much of a problem conquering the city with your tasty pizzas.
debriefing: Congratulations! You have passed your first test in the pizza business with flying colours! From now on, you are entirely on your own. To start with, we are sending you to Berlin where you must finally get our company established.

name: Madrid
briefing: Spain, sunny Spain. There can be no doubt about your climb up the career ladder. But Spaniards and tourists have very different tastes. Fortunately for you, you know all about the German and English tourists from your work in their native countries. Your task is difficult: Draw the prosperous, spend-happy tourists into your overpriced restaurants and at the same time provide Madrid's high society with top-class pizza.
debriefing: Alarm at HQ. Your restaurants in Paris are going broke one after the other. The company sends their best man - you - to Paris. Get the lost market share back.

name: Moscow
briefing: From the capital of the pizza to the capital of crime. You should pause over a good pizza and a glass of red wine to think about your employer's attitude towards you. The Russian Mafia is feared for their brutality, and your boss would apparently have no problems forgiving the Mafia if you came to a sad end. Do not expect consideration in this situation, and do not give anyone any yourself.
debriefing: On your own initiative, you have decided to prove to your boss what you are really worth and take off for Tokyo.

name: Paris
briefing: You are supposed to conquer the culinary Garden of Eden with pizza. The French gourmet chefs are not at all pleased with your arrival and will do anything they can to ruin your reputation. But the city offers a wealth of opportunities, and your experience with the Madrid underworld will undoubtedly stand you in good stead.
debriefing: Your career has reached a new high. The home of the pizza is put into your hands. Off to Rome.

name: Rio de Janeiro
briefing: In your current situation, a city that has never heard of your former boss's pizza appears very opportune. But don't let the beauties on the Copacabana distract you from your business. In Rio, as elsewhere, you are only worth as much as the bullet of the gangster who finishes you off. The protection money you collect from your competitors here in Rio will be the only start-up capital you have for the next city!
debriefing: New York. After smuggling your suitcase full of ill-gotten gains through customs, you are ready to challenge him at the centre of his authority.  You have enough capital for a modest beginning. Now comes the moment of truth!

name: Roma
briefing: You cannot allow yourself to make any mistakes here. Your boss expects perfect recipes, the corrupt Italian politicians want to go on holiday again - at your expense, naturally - and the Mafia has long had a prosperous relationship with your competitors. So the home of your ancestors will demand of you much more than just good economics.
debriefing: A short telegram instructs you to take the next plane to Sydney. What is the matter with your boss? After your `clean` work in the cradle of the pizza, now you have to go to this culinary desert.

name: Sydney
briefing: Australia is waiting for your pizza. But the market is firmly in the grasp of the fast-food chains. You won't have the ghost of a chance in this sector. Come up with new methods and show the Australians the delights of the classic pizza and the wonderful atmosphere of the pizzeria. That is why management insists that almost all of the restaurants be furnished only in a rustic style.
debriefing: A messenger brings you a ticket to Moscow. Apparently your business abilities are slowly beginning to appear dangerous to the management in New York.

name: Tokyo
briefing: Your general power of representation has helped you to take over the Far East division of the company. But now you have to establish your restaurant chain before your employer notices what you are up to and stops your culinary campaign. While Japan is not exactly the home of the pizza, the Japanese shouldn't be able to resist your marketing skills.
debriefing: Your success has made your boss feel even more threatened in his position. Your unauthorized activities finally give your boss the opportunity to fire you in spite of your successes. Your only hope of staying in the business is to found your own pizza empire and force your former boss out of business. But to do that, you have to come up with the necessary capital.

name: New York
briefing: Your spies have told you that your ex-boss has made peace with the other families and is expecting you. So do not underestimate his economic power and his excellent relations to the other honourable families. Pay attention to your HQ and be prepared for dirty tricks from your ex-boss. After all, you have known him for quite a while!
debriefing: Victory!!! Thanks to your good relationship to the city administration, the petty investigations of the local police have not caused you any difficulties. You bought your ex-employer's 15-meter-long Cadillac cheaply at an auction, along with the rest of his estate, and tomorrow you are moving into his villa on Long Island. You have sent a promising young man to Berlin to take over your European restaurants.
